title: fix(spec)!: composeStacks reads a nested artifact's package bodies for action key collisions, refusing the pair install refuses (ADR-0150 D4)

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgJSRdLSMks47MshHcmtLwgx)_
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CagEpJKupV36gSK4mY

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`composeStacks` 第 6 步（跨栈动作键冲突检查）现在也读「嵌套产物」（自带 `packages[]` 的输入，例如 preserve 组合出的多包产物）里每个包体的动作，并用安装门同一条命名空间规则（`namespacedHoldersMeet`）判定。
- 为什么改：多包产物只在包体里带动作，旧检查只看顶层，所以「嵌套产物 + 与其某包同命名空间、声明同名对象外动作的第三个包」被放行；逐个安装同样三个包时第三个会被拒（NAMESPACE_CONFLICT）。放行后启动出来的结果：preserve 下两个地址都 409、谁都调不到；默认 manifest 下静默只跑第三个包的。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄（BREAKING）：原本放行的上述组合改为 422 STACK_COMPOSE_ACTION_KEY_COLLISION；不带 `packages[]` 的输入判法逐字节不变；第一方普查 0。只改 spec 一个文件的私有函数，runtime 不动；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 第 6 步新增的包体遍历（约 7854 行起）与 `composedPackagesHoldApart`（约 7975 行）；`compose-stacks-action-key-collision.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/compose-stacks-action-key-collision.test.ts`，预期 41/41 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #32335

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — `composeStacks` refuses, `422 STACK_COMPOSE_ACTION_KEY_COLLISION`, a composition it admitted before: an input that already carries `packages[]` (a nested artifact) beside another input that declares an action key one of its package bodies declares, when the install gate would refuse the pair. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` names `composeStacks` only as an existence pointer (`skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md`) and teaches no composition collision rule; the prescription ships in the refusal text.

## What changes

`composeStacks` step 6 (`collectComposedActionKeyCollisions`, `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`) walked each input's top-level `actions` and the composed objects only. A multi-package artifact composed under `manifest: 'preserve'` strips its flattened copy and carries its actions only in `packages[]` bodies, so composing it again beside a third package saw one declaring stack for a key two packages hold, and admitted the pair whatever the namespaces. The boot (`actionBindingGroups`, `@objectstack/runtime`) reads every body, and the install gate judges every package, so compose was the one door that did not.

- **Reads the bodies.** For every input carrying `packages[]`, each body (`entry.manifest`) contributes its `actions` (keyed `objectName || 'global'`, as the top-level walk keys them) and the `actions` of its objects, noted against that input at `packages[K].actions[J]` / `packages[K].objects['OBJECT'].actions[J]`, with the body as holder: its id read as `id || name` (the spelling `artifactPackageId` keys every package by) and its namespace. A body object the composed top level also carries is skipped: the top level claims it at the boot, and the existing walk already judged what it carries.
- **Judges with the shared predicate.** `composedPackagesHoldApart` now takes, per input, who declares the key: a flat input is its manifest (unchanged); a nested input contributes each body that declares it, and a nested input whose own top level declares the key holds nothing apart (unchanged: that declaration belongs to no single body). No two holders may be one package and no two may meet under `namespacedHoldersMeet`, the namespace half of the install gate's rule.
- **Strictly narrowing.** Every key refused before is still refused: before, a nested input reached a key only through its top level, which still refuses; reading bodies only adds declarers, and a key is admitted only if every pair of holders is apart. Inputs with no `packages[]` contribute nothing new, so a flat composition is judged byte for byte as before.
- **No contract shape moves.** No authorable key, schema shape or `api-surface` export (two private interfaces and one private helper in `stack.zod.ts`). Runtime unchanged: the boot already reads each body (measured below), so once compose refuses, the boot never sees the pair. Triage route ruling 6796273876 (stays `domain:server`, the spec hunk rides this PR); step 0 ruled by the seat (6807368544).

### Before / after, each case (A = `alpha` (namespace alpha, holds object-less `send_note`) + `beta`, composed under `'preserve'`)

| case | before (main 14754c70) | after |
|---|---|---|
| A + `alpha2` (namespace alpha, `send_note`), `'preserve'` | ACCEPTED; install refuses `alpha2` `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT 422`; the boot answers `409` at both `/actions/global/send_note` and `/actions/alpha/global/send_note` | REFUSED `422 STACK_COMPOSE_ACTION_KEY_COLLISION`, issue `… 'com.example.beta' (stack #0) at packages[0].actions[0] and 'com.example.alpha2' (stack #1) at stack.actions[0].`, no preserve hint |
| A + `alpha2`, default manifest | ACCEPTED; the boot runs `alpha2`'s body at both addresses, alpha's silently shadowed | REFUSED, same code and issue, no preserve hint |
| A + `gamma` (namespace gamma), `'preserve'` | ACCEPTED | ACCEPTED (CONTROL), packages `[alpha, beta, gamma]` |
| A + `gamma`, default manifest | ACCEPTED (the same pair of flat inputs was refused) | REFUSED, and the refusal names `manifest: 'preserve'`, as the flat pair's does |
| A (body object `alpha_item` embeds `approve`) + addon binding `approve` to `alpha_item`, `'preserve'` | ACCEPTED | REFUSED, issue at `packages[0].objects['alpha_item'].actions[0]` (one-holder rule for an object-bound key) |
| flat inputs (`alpha` + `alpha2` / `alpha` + `gamma`) | refused at `stack.actions[0]` / composed | unchanged (CONTROL) |

(The stack label of A is `'com.example.beta'`: A takes its last input's manifest.)

### Census

`git grep -n "composeStacks(" -- examples packages ':!*.test.ts'` at 8be0f346 → one call, `examples/app-multi-package/objectstack.config.ts:68`, composing two flat stacks (no `packages[]` input) that declare no actions. First-party affected: **0**.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/compose-stacks-action-key-collision.test.ts`, one new top-level `describe` in the existing harness (7 cases): the nested input's shape; A + one-namespace package refused under `'preserve'` and under the default manifest (`code` + `status` + the exact `issues` path); CONTROL A + two-namespace package composes under `'preserve'`; that pair refused under the default manifest naming `'preserve'`; the object-bound key a body embeds; CONTROL flat inputs unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- Read from the tree, NOT MEASURED: `mergeObjects` walks top-level `objects` only, so a stripped nested artifact's body objects are not judged against a third input's same-named object either. That is the object strategy, not this card's action rule; not touched here.

## Verification

Record at head 8be0f346 (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`).

<details><summary>Step 1 measurement on main 14754c70 (before)</summary>

A temporary rig (not committed) under `packages/runtime/src/domains/`, run on the built `@objectstack/runtime` closure under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, Tests 2/2), with A = `com.qa.m.p1` (namespace alpha, `qa_send_note`) + `com.qa.m.p2` (beta) under `'preserve'`, q = `com.qa.m.q` (namespace alpha, depends on p1, `qa_send_note`), r = `com.qa.m.r` (gamma):

```
CONTROL flat composeStacks([p1, q], preserve) : REFUSED STACK_COMPOSE_ACTION_KEY_COLLISION 422
composeStacks([A, q], preserve)               : ACCEPTED packages [p1, p2, q]
composeStacks([A, q])                         : ACCEPTED packages [p1, p2]
composeStacks([A, r], preserve)               : ACCEPTED
composeStacks([A, r])                         : ACCEPTED
boot(A+q preserve) POST /actions/global/qa_send_note        : 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT naming p1 and q
boot(A+q preserve) POST /actions/alpha/global/qa_send_note  : 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT naming p1 and q
boot(A+q default)  POST /actions/global/qa_send_note        : 200 {"from":"q"}
boot(A+q default)  POST /actions/alpha/global/qa_send_note  : 200 {"from":"q"}
install p1, p2, q one by one after the seal   : p1 admitted, p2 admitted, q REFUSED BareNameConflictError NAMESPACE_CONFLICT 422
```
</details>
